name: Aegex 100M
statusNote: Availability unclear: Aegex's website has gone offline and a distributor lists it as end of life, though another still shows stock. Eaton sells a tablet with identical specifications.
summary: The Aegex 100M is an intrinsically safe (Ex ia) 10.1-inch Windows tablet from Aegex, certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Windows 11 IoT Enterprise. It has been discontinued; the Eaton MTL GECMA IS Tablet PC replaces it.

otherSchemes: CSA Class I Zone 1/0 listing (per distributors)
India certification announced by Aegex (news page seen only as a search result

atex.marking: II 1G Ex ia IIC T4 Ga / II 1D Ex ia IIIC T135°C Da
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 1 (2026-02-20), checked 2026-10-25. The earlier IECEx SNA 24.0004X (Ex ia IIB T4 Ga) was CANCELLED on 2025-10-22 at the CB's request after consulting the applicant. Cancellation does not affect equipment already released.

iecex.marking: Ex ia IIC T4 Ga / Ex ia IIIC T135°C Da

certification.northAmerica: UL 913 8th ed.: Class I, II, III Div 1 and Div 2 Groups C, D T4; Class I Zone 0 AEx ia IIB T4 Ga (gas group IIB in North America, not IIC); CSA C22.2 No. 60079-0/-11
certification.zone0Note: Zone 0 rated only inside the case supplied by the maker.

safety.conditions: IECEx NMK 25.0015X conditions: do not remove or replace the battery pack in hazardous areas; use only battery pack AAEB-100-XX and charge it only on the tablet; charge only with Aegex charger AAAK-0XX-01; do not open the SIM/SD port in a hazardous location; in Zone 0 the product must be used inside the Aegex leather case APAC-100-01 (aluminium enclosure, friction hazard); avoid friction on the enclosure; inspect for damage; service only by Aegex; do not charge, connect or disconnect in hazardous areas; no accessories or extensions in hazardous areas; Ta −20 °C to +55 °C.
safety.peripherals: No accessories or extensions in hazardous areas; do not open the SIM/SD port, do not connect or disconnect anything (charging contact, dock) in hazardous areas.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Zone 0 leather case APAC-100-01 (mandatory in Zone 0), battery AAEB-100-XX, charger AAAK-0XX-01, DS100M dock (safe area only), shoulder strap and stylus in the box. No Ex-rated peripherals are allowed in the Ex area.

os.name: Windows
os.edition: Windows 11 IoT Enterprise (channel/LTSC year not stated; Eaton: 'Windows 11 IoT')

specs.chip: Intel quad-core Atom (Apollo Lake) 1.6 GHz base, 1.8 GHz burst
specs.camera: 8 MP autofocus with flash (Eaton: camera-free version available)
specs.frontCamera: Front camera 1920 x 1080 stills (megapixels not stated; 2 MP in Eaton manual)
specs.ports: 5-pin magnetic charging connector; docking connector (LAN, USB 2.0/3.0, USB-C, HDMI, SD, audio jack); microSDXC and nano-SIM under port cover; VESA 75 x 35 mm mount (Eaton)
specs.docking: Dock DS100M (Aegex) / GEC-ATP-DOST-01 (Eaton), safe area only; shoulder strap; VESA mount
specs.partNumbers: A100MW1CB0A01 (Connection.com listing); Zone 0 case APAC-100-01; charger AAAK-0XX-01; dock DS100M

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Via app (AegexScan; camera-based, no dedicated engine)

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (front and rear cameras; Windows app)

unconfirmed.certification.atex.marking: The IECEx marking is from the certificate. The ATEX version is from a distributor and Eaton's identical certificate; the ATEX certificate isn't published.
unconfirmed.certification.iecex.marking: The IECEx marking is from the certificate. The ATEX version is from a distributor and Eaton's identical certificate; the ATEX certificate isn't published.
unconfirmed.certification.otherSchemes: Stated by the maker; we haven't seen the certificate.
unconfirmed.os.edition: The maker doesn't state the edition year.
unconfirmed.os.securityUntil: Microsoft's end date for Windows 11 IoT Enterprise LTSC 2024. The maker doesn't state the edition year.
unconfirmed.launchYear: Approximate: the maker doesn't publish a launch date. Based on the certificate date or the maker's announcement.

strengths: Zone 0 rated when used in the supplied case
ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
Also certified for Class I Division 1 in North America
limitations: Discontinued; the Eaton MTL GECMA IS Tablet PC replaces it
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
